title: VirtualKeyRequest
description: Issue a gateway virtual key to an active agent instance (FR-702, E6.1). MVP: only operator-appointed gateway administrators may manage keys. Verified owner/sponsor self-service is deferred. The secret is shown once in the response and never stored.

aliases.description: Model aliases the key may call; each must be one the instance's template allows.

monthlyBudget.description: Calls are refused once the recorded spend of calls authorized in the current UTC calendar month reaches it. Calls in flight can overshoot; the overshoot is reported, not hidden.

maxCallsWithoutUsage.description: How many of the key's calls within a rolling 24 hours may run without a usage report: a call the client aborted (the provider likely bills it, but the gateway reports no usage), or one still unaccounted 15 minutes after authorization. Once more have, calls are refused until enough fall out of the window. Calls in flight when the limit is reached can overshoot it. Omitted means 10; 0 refuses the key after the first such call. Fixed at issuance.

maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Calls the key may make within any rolling minute; more are refused with HTTP 429. Omitted means 60. Fixed at issuance.

maxCallsInFlight.description: Model calls the key may have in flight at once (authorized, with no usage, missing-usage or failure report yet, within 15 minutes); more are refused with HTTP 429. Bounds how far budgets and the calls-without-usage allowance can be overshot. Omitted means 4. Fixed at issuance.
